ModMetaData.name: SOS2 Weapon Readouts
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
The per-shot heat and power numbers Save Our Ship 2 does not show.
- Per-shot heat and electrical draw on a weapon's information card - Built weapons append a compact value to the existing network-heat line instead of adding a row - Placement previews warn about no thermal network, no ship bridge, or too little capacity for one shot - Changes no balance
Requires Save Our Ship 2 and its Vehicle Framework dependency, plus Harmony and SpineLib.
